name: Hōdatsu-shimizu (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Hōdatsu-shimizu town emblem in green and blue: a green ring with a pointed top and a blue disc above blue waves.
history: Municipal flag of Hōdatsu-shimizu, a town in Ishikawa Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 1 July 2005.

features.role: Hōdatsu-shimizu town emblem — a green ring with a pointed top and a blue disc above blue waves
